skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of physics including forces, energy, heat, radiation, and physical properties of solids, liquids, and gases.
Grasp fundamental concepts of environmental science such as pollution types, climate change, and renewable energy sources.
Analyze natural disasters like earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis using physical principles.
Evaluate the impact of various phenomena on the environment and propose solutions to mitigate risks.
Develop skills in searching, collecting, analyzing, and presenting information related to environmental issues.
Enhance teamwork skills through group assignments and discussion sessions.
